rationale: ContinuityOps is a coherent lab-grade scaffold: independence/validators, hardened Helm, serverless source+tests, SLO/alert catalogs, strong drills/runbooks, and agentic deny-by-default policy are real strengths with generally honest synthetic labeling. Residual defects that block a clean merge-ready yes are deployable-artifact gaps (PENDING image digest, stub worker.zip vs tested source, unemitted restore evidence) plus STATUS/accuracy artifacts that overclaim completeness relative to those gaps. No Project A/C edits or secret spills observed in sampled paths.
